column1: # A session's own scratch folder, with real folders made in the system temp folder on each
# run. Columns, by tab: expect, tool, command. In a command:
#   {O} another session's, beside it; {P} their shared parent folder, <temp>/<test>/project
#   {L} a link inside {S} that leads out of the temp folder
#   {D} a folder named for this session's id that is itself a link out of the temp folder
# The worktree is /work/repo, or C:\work\repo on Windows. The sign ⏎ stands for a newline.
# What an allowed row deletes is made first: on Windows the whole path must exist.
# The audit's false alarms (effort 388), allowed now.

column3: S={S} && cd $S && sed -n 1p a.txt; rm -rf build
cd /work/repo/sub && cargo build --locked && S={S}/preview && rm -rf "$S" && mkdir -p "$S"
D="{S}/rb"; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D" && cd "$D" && for f in a b; do echo $f; done
S={S}/fmt; cd /work/repo && rm -rf $S/copy && for f in a b; do cp $f $S/copy/$f; done

column1: # Still denied: another session's folder, the shared parent, shared temp, and links out.
# A link the command makes first isn't there when the guard looks (review, 388).
# A cd after || or ! may not have run.

column3: S={S}/x; while true; do rm -rf $S; S=/etc; done
